profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a versatile and experienced senior software developer offering expertise in software development, information technology, and operations. I have a proven track-record of designing and executing strategic development initiatives aligned with organizational objectives with a focus on end-user satisfaction and engagement. I am an individual dedicated to personal improvement who exceeds performance metrics. 
 

RESULTS: I recently led a portfolio of projects valued at over $62MM, implementing innovative back-end solutions and driving initiatives such as solving database performance issues for a $5MM system while ensuring less than $500K in labor costs. 


RESULTS-DRIVEN, CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATOR: I am a collaborative team leader continually focused on building relationships to produce highly effective cross-functional teams, increasing productivity, and improving outcomes. 

 
CONTACT ME: wil@wilj.net 


Specialties: 

INDUSTRY SKILLS: ✰ Software Development ✰ Project Management ✰ Technical Leadership ✰ Client Services ✰ Data & Analytics ✰ Cross-functional Leadership ✰ Cost Optimization ✰ Operational Processes ✰ Efficiency Improvements ✰ Business Development ✰ Process Optimization ✰ Quality Assurance 

 

 

 

PROFESSIONAL ATTRIBUTES:  ✰  Dynamic ✰  Analytical ✰ Strategic ✰ Collaborative ✰ Motivated ✰ Solutions-focused ✰ Organized ✰ Innovative ✰ Proactive ✰ Versatile ✰ Resourceful ✰ Detail-Oriented ✰ Excellent Communication Skills ✰ Self-Starter ✰ Leader ✰ Problem-Solver

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led a portfolio of projects valued at over $62MM, implementing innovative back-end solutions and driving initiatives such as solving database performance issues for a $5MM system while ensuring less than $500K in labor costs. 

Created a mentorship program for 50+ developers to improve 150+ applications on SQL and Java performance tuning, eliminating system outages for over 500K users with >90% drop in peak enterprise database utilization. 

Launched a new portal to save over $100K in annual backend maintenance costs, supervising a 3-person DevOps team to spearhead the infrastructure team’s transition to React + Typescript + Spring Boot as their web application stack. 

Designed and developed web services to back the water quality portal for a task force valued at $10.8MM, saving 20+ billable hours per project iteration to reduce process costs by over $50K. 

Managed a cross-functional team of 2 developers to maintain and fix internal systems, overseeing a Java developer and Oracle DBA to exceed all performance metrics while maintaining 100% retention rate year-over-year.

positions.title: Software Engineer – Independent Contractor
positions.description:
Served as the lead software engineer to drive projects to secure grants valued at over $128MM, increasing the company’s customer base from 13 to 60+ healthcare organizations while meeting 100% of project deadlines. 

Increased “Healthy Start” grants participation and payouts for clients and their customers for 2 consecutive years, receiving recognition as the #1 out of 5 organizations by streamlining processes to analyze and upload required data. 

Resolved 100+ outstanding tickets within the first 2 weeks as the project lead, focused on fixing data loss and corruption issues to successfully retain 5 clients who were at risk to terminate their contracts with the company.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer – Java Developer
positions.description:
Oversaw a suite of projects to modernize field inspection systems valued at over $20MM, managing a team of 6 developers while implementing a variety of process optimizations to improve outcomes and exceed 100% of KPIs. 

Implemented a series of cost optimization initiatives to save over $500K in annual maintenance expenses, analyzing systems to successfully reduce codebase from 820K to 400K lines. 

Eliminated 100+ data corruption issues due to unresolved query results, developing parameters for 4 Java developers and 1 Oracle DBA to add runtime cardinality constraint checks for all queries.

volunteerExperiences.description:
I volunteer through Community Connections, a diversion program in partnership with the Department of Juvenile Justice in Tallahassee, Florida.

Typically, teens come to us as a diversion option to court, as part of their probation, or as a community referral.

We help the participants develop their emotional intelligence, empathy, and conflict resolution skills using a process called Nonviolent Communication.

The program reduces recidivism by over 84%.  Many graduates return to volunteer as youth caseworkers.

We have formed Connection First, Inc. as a nonprofit organization to promote restorative practices in schools.  Our goal is to end the school-to-prison pipeline.

https://wilj.net/nvc/community/
